title: Boss: The Tangled Script
story: The Knot Spider has tied a script into a tangle. Write a tidy one that handles every case.
goal: Read numbers from standard input (one per line). Ignore blank lines and any line that is not a whole number. Print count, sum, min and max, one per line as count=N, sum=N, min=N, max=N. With no numbers print count=0 only.
hints: Test each line with [[ $n =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]] and skip bad ones with continue.
Keep min and max empty until the first number, then compare with -lt and -gt.

count=0; sum=0; min=; max=
while read -r n; do
  [[ $n =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
  count=$((count + 1)); sum=$((sum + n))
  if [ -z "$min" ] || [ "$n" -lt "$min" ]; then min=$n; fi
  if [ -z "$max" ] || [ "$n" -gt "$max" ]; then max=$n; fi
done
echo "count=$count"
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "sum=$sum"; echo "min=$min"; echo "max=$max"
fi
socratic: What should happen to a blank line?
Why start min and max empty?
What does the output look like with no numbers?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Boss: The Tangled Script”?
solution:

  if [ -z "$max" ] || [ "$n" -gt "$max" ]; then max=$n; fi
done
echo "count=$count"
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "sum=$sum"; echo "min=$min"; echo "max=$max"
fi
